I found a real handoff defect in the character-creation UI: it receives `tutorialTipCount` from `main.js` but the UI function never destructures it, so its “completed tutorial” detection is hard-coded to 15 while the catalog now has 36 tips. I’m checking whether that explains the observed selection failure and will add a regression test/fix around the actual preference handoff.

The historical intent confirms the tutorial toggle is meant to resume partial progress and replay after completion. The current UI silently ignores the supplied catalog count, which is why its completion state is stale after the guide grew from 15 to 36 tips. I’m fixing that parameter handoff and adding the required version bump.
